title: Marketing website for DrawdownKing

requirements.text: Create a responsive marketing website for the DrawdownKing brand with a single-page layout that clearly communicates the brand name, purpose, and offerings.
acceptanceCriteria: Landing page renders without errors and prominently displays the DrawdownKing name.
Page includes clear sections for: Purpose (what it is/why it exists) and Offerings (what is provided).
Layout is responsive and usable on mobile, tablet, and desktop widths.

requirements.text: Implement a simple navigation and page structure suitable for a marketing site, including a header with navigation links (scroll-to sections) and a footer with basic brand and contact placeholders (no external integrations).
acceptanceCriteria: Header navigation links scroll to the correct sections on the page.
Footer is present and includes brand name plus placeholder contact text (in English).
No external email/CRM integrations are required for contact placeholders.

requirements.text: Add one cohesive, distinctive visual theme (colors, typography, spacing, and component style) and apply it consistently across the marketing site. Do not use a blue-and-purple theme.
acceptanceCriteria: A consistent theme is evident across header, sections, buttons, and footer.
Theme avoids blue-and-purple as the dominant palette.
Typography and spacing are consistent across sections.

requirements.text: Include basic on-page marketing elements: a hero section with a headline and short subtext, at least one call-to-action button, and an offerings section presented as a small set of feature cards.
acceptanceCriteria: Hero section contains a headline, a short descriptive paragraph, and at least one CTA button.
Offerings are shown as distinct cards/tiles with titles and short descriptions.
All user-facing text is in English.

requirements.text: Add generated static image assets for brand presentation (logo + hero illustration/background) and render them in the site from static paths (not via backend).
acceptanceCriteria: Generated images are placed under frontend/public/assets/generated.
Site references these images via static paths and displays them (logo in header and/or hero; hero visual in hero section).
No backend endpoints are used to serve or transform images.

constraints: Use English for all user-facing text.

Do not edit files in frontend immutablePaths (frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui). Compose existing UI components rather than modifying them.
Backend must remain single-actor Motoko architecture if backend changes are later introduced.
nonGoals: Third-party integrations for email, analytics, or social logins

required: Minimalist wordmark logo with crown motif, dark-on-light (drawdownking-logo.dim_512x256.png)
Abstract financial drawdown chart hero illustration with bold shapes, warm palette (drawdownking-hero-illustration.dim_1600x900.png)
Set of 3 simple line icons matching the brand style (risk, strategy, performance) (drawdownking-icons-set.dim_512x512.png)
